text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Dad! Hurry, hurry!
Big Sis's race is about to start!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Father
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Su-chan. Don't run!
The hood of your raincoat came off.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh... The Tenno Sho (Autumn) crowd is insane...
Ines is in another crazy race, huh...

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~. But if it's her,
she'll probably do it again today—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, may I ask you something?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"What do you think is the difference
between me and Ryan-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ines Fuujin's words made me ponder. Mejiro Ryan belongs to the Mejiro family, and Ines Fuujin is the Umamusume I train.
choice_data_list: First of all, the muscle mass is completely different.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, it's different.
choice_data_list: And their upbringings are different too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That's true too.
choice_data_list: The feelings we put into the race are different, too

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...That's true, nanoma.
Ryan-chan is trying to shoulder the Mejiro name
right alongside McQueen-chan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I just want to run, so I run.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Me, who essentially has nothing to my name,
and just runs purely on my own feelings.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Why did you keep cheering for me?
choice_data_list: Because you gave it your all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Giving it your all?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Toward academy life, family, part-time jobs, and racing alike.
choice_data_list: I love the way you run, giving it your all
I love watching you give it your all when you run

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...! Come to think of it, you mentioned that before.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "You said, 'I love seeing you run so happily.' Wait, could it be you've felt that way ever since back then—"
choice_data_list: I'm sure everyone feels the same way.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Saying, 'I love the you that runs happily.'
Could it be that ever since back then, you—"
choice_data_list: I'm sure everyone feels the same way.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone else, too?
choice_data_list: We all want to dream alongside you.
We all want to dream with you

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I see... You want to dream together with me, huh.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's plenty! I got a great answer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm off to the paddock!
I'll let you taste it too.
The joy of victory, right alongside me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I get it now, Ryan-chan.
The reason you told me I "didn't have to shoulder it alone.")

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Fans
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-saaan!
Show them the pride of the Mejiro family on this stage!
I have high hopes! For your victory!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (The words and hopes that McQueen-chan and Ryan-chan have received are a little different from what I've been given.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Most of what was placed on those two
were hopes and expectations of wanting them to be a certain way. But...)

text_block_list.name: Ines's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Big siiiis! Do your best!
You've totally got this, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "...If anything, rather than having heavy expectations placed on me, I feel like people are just purely cheering me on~."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Then there's no need to shoulder it alone.
After all, we're dreaming this dream together."
